terminal.judul: Penyerang mencoba membuka portal Kodim A
terminal.perintah:
n=0; gagal=0
while [ $n -lt 600 ]; do
  n=$((n+1)); w=$(TZ=WIB-7 date +%H:%M:%S.%3N)
  k=$(curl -s -m 1 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://172.30.0.11/)
  if [ "$k" = "200" ]; then echo "$w GET http://172.30.0.11/ -> HTTP $k (tersambung)";
  else gagal=$((gagal+1))
    if [ $gagal -eq 1 ]; then echo "$w GET http://172.30.0.11/ -> kode $k"; echo "Koneksi penyerang ke Kodim A TERPUTUS (kode $k). Blokir nftables bekerja.";
    else echo "$w GET http://172.30.0.11/ -> kode $k (masih terputus)"; fi
    [ $gagal -ge 4 ] && break
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done
